description: This file is a shell script that automates testing of the 'git svn branch' functionality within a project. It includes setup commands for creating a subversion repository, importing it into git, and testing various branch and tag operations using git svn commands.

methods.name: svn_cmd
methods.description: Executed to run svn commands, likely a wrapper around svn CLI with added logging or error handling.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Sets up a test case expecting the enclosed commands to succeed.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Runs commands expecting them to fail, used to verify incorrect operations are correctly rejected.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the completion of the set of tests.
